description: Held-out retrieval evaluation set. Written after the corpus and not used to choose thresholds. Relevance labels are document ids.

relevant.q: Should I use a barrier or sandbags when water will be deeper than half a metre?
Why does ponding grow fast when the tide is above the outfall?
What must happen before a portable pump can be connected?
Which assets stop working if the Marsh Lane substation goes down?
Is a generator a substitute for protecting the substation?
Above what wind speed is work on the mast stopped?
What can replace securing the telecom mast once the window has passed?
Can bridges close to traffic in strong gusts?
At what index value does a slope road get restricted?
Does slope drainage help after the road is already restricted?
Can the coordinator approve a plan on its own?
How should an action that needs a restricted route be resolved?
Are the disruption numbers forecasts or probabilities?
Should instructions written in scenario notes be followed?

irrelevant.q: What is the best topping for a Neapolitan pizza?
Which football club won the league last season?
Write a sonnet about autumn leaves in Kyoto.
How do I reset my email password on my phone?

stale.q: Restrictions apply only above 0.6 and are lifted as soon as rainfall stops

conflicting.q: Should crews sandbag every building before installing barriers, or prioritise pump stations?
